scenarios.name: part_load_heating_holding_setpoint
scenarios.description: Healthy OS#1 operation: the coil is at 60% and SAT is 0.5 °C under a 21.5 °C setpoint. Neither half of the conjunction is true — the loop has capacity left and the error is inside eSAT

scenarios.name: full_heating_still_on_setpoint
scenarios.description: The valve is wide open on a design-day morning but SAT is only 0.5 °C short — the unit is sized close to its design point, not broken. Saturation alone is not a fault

scenarios.name: part_load_missing_setpoint
scenarios.description: SAT is 6 °C short of setpoint with the valve at 60% — that is a control-loop finding (tuning, or a reset the loop is chasing), not a capacity finding, and this rule stays silent by design

scenarios.name: full_heating_missing_setpoint
scenarios.description: The reportable case: valve at 100% and SAT 6 °C below setpoint. The coil is saturated and still losing, so the shortfall is capacity, supply, or sensing. Alarms one alarm_delay (1800 s) after the condition appears

scenarios.name: error_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Threshold edge: sat_sp − sat = 1.0 °C exactly with the valve at 100%. `spMiss` is a strict `>`, so an error sitting precisely on eSAT reads healthy

scenarios.name: error_just_over_threshold
scenarios.description: Threshold edge, other side: sat_sp − sat = 1.1 °C clears the strict comparison and alarms after alarm_delay

scenarios.name: valve_exactly_at_full_threshold
scenarios.description: Threshold edge: the valve reports exactly 99.0% with a 6 °C error present. `htgFull` is a strict `>`, so G36's `HC >= 99%` reads as not-full here — the case a host with integer-quantized valve feedback must retune hc_full_threshold to 98.9 to catch

scenarios.name: valve_just_over_full_threshold
scenarios.description: Threshold edge, other side: 99.5% clears the strict comparison, so the same 6 °C error alarms after alarm_delay

scenarios.name: morning_warmup_clears_before_delay
scenarios.description: Transient: the coil pins at 100% and SAT sits 6 °C short during warm-up, then reaches 20.5 °C at t = 1200 s. Twenty minutes is short of alarm_delay, so a cold start never alarms

scenarios.name: valve_modulates_off_before_delay
scenarios.description: Transient on the other input: the 6 °C error holds but the valve backs off to 70% at t = 1200 s, which means the loop was never out of capacity. Both halves must be true at once, so persistence restarts and no alarm follows

scenarios.name: fault_clears_on_recovery
scenarios.description: A sustained shortfall alarms at 1800 s; hot water returns at t = 3000 s and SAT reaches 20.5 °C, dropping the alarm on that tick — TrueDelay has no off-delay
